source: Use only the locked Nomophobia development-only whole-round split in human-development.json. Reject ambiguous or GUI-open frames and preserve empty rounds in coverage. The samples are ordinary local MMC duels against scripted bots. Never include this player on a held-out human roster.
inputs: Pair first-person tick start with same tick-end applied forward/strafe and grounded jump. Physical left-button-down within the tick is the attack label, capped to a binary gate. Read local main-thread hurt handlers before the head. Use past applied controls, rendered target changes and own state. Never read the opponent POV. Aim offsets and sub-tick physical intervals are descriptive. The proxy has standard tracking aim and requests sprint with forward.
proxy: Fit a conditional 16-unit softsign MLP with categorical longitudinal and lateral actions and Bernoulli physical press and grounded jump. Give it the previous input and bounded elapsed heads since a press, jump, longitudinal change or strafe change. Sample its distribution on a deterministic private random stream, separately frozen across development and validation. Compare teacher-forced log loss and per-head action frequencies to unconditional and previous-input-only baselines. Choose seed and training epoch on selection rounds and only then score the later same-player rounds. Evaluate separate high-CPS stress with the learned movement and private timing rhythm but attack gate open.
challenger: First measure existing W-tap, Hold-W, champion and targeted adversaries against both proxies on original development clocks. Permit human-informed optimization if a stronger response exists or the champion drops games. Optimize ring-outs in a mixed population of human-informed proxies and ordinary strong fixed controllers using only original training clocks. Keep W-tap and Hold-W controls, both seats and both RTTs. Choose challenge weights before obtaining new mirror clocks, then test a different set of proxy draw streams. An evaluator never sees an opponent name or random seed.
promotion: Compare challenger, strongest previously frozen candidate and W-tap on matched model and main-lab Forge ring-outs. Development and same-player checks establish proxy fidelity only. Do not interpret proxy wins as wins against Nomophobia or elite players.
